messages:
sam_partner_success: Heads-up — Acme (tenant t-acme-001) reports partner promo `ACME-DEDICATE-50` was redeemed but appears on their Hosted org. They can't provision Dedicated capacity; UI shows 'insufficient reserved credit'. Can billing confirm allocation?

jenny_support: noted. can you paste tenant id + promo code? i'll pull audit logs.

sam_partner_success: tenant `t-acme-001`, promo `ACME-DEDICATE-50`, partner portal ref `pr-9981`. customer says partner rep applied it during onboarding.

jenny_support: thanks. pinging @tara_billing and @mike_eng_oncall. @tara can you check promo allocation & ledger?

tara_billing: looking now. i see promo redeemed on org `a-hosted-475` at 2024-11-02T14:12:08Z by `partner-sync` user. ledger entry: promo `ACME-DEDICATE-50` -> credit_id `c-7890` amount `$5,000` product: hosted.

jenny_support: ugh. system mis-tagged product. do we have admin tooling to reassign?

tara_billing: we can reassign but it requires a manual transfer with audit trail. opening internal billing ticket BL-7421 and requesting expedited approval. need dest org id for Dedicated (billing) so we can move credit.

sam_partner_success: dest org for dedicated is `org-ded-112`. customer is target tenant. they are blocked from provisioning and are on a tight launch timeline this week.

mike_eng_oncall: provisioning errors from control plane look like this: 
```
{"error":"insufficient_reserved_credit","code":"DEDICATED_PROVISION_FAILED","required":5000,"available":0}
```
this check happens before scheduling GPU nodes so UX is blocked.

sam_partner_success: customer asks for emergency reassign to Dedicated to unblock.

tara_billing: finance needs to OK an expedited transfer. i've flagged BL-7421 as P1 and CC'd finance. payload we need: source credit `c-7890`, from org `a-hosted-475`, to org `org-ded-112`, amount 5000, note: "ACME partner promo reassign".

jenny_support: pasting the admin CLI command for audit. tara, please run after approval:

```
billing-cli transfer-credit --credit-id c-7890 --from-org a-hosted-475 --to-org org-ded-112 --amount 5000 --reason "partner portal mislabel"
```

audit-bot: audit event recorded: event_id `ev-33421` actor=jenny_support action=created_transfer_request credit=c-7890

tara_billing: finance replied by email and approved expedited transfer. running the transfer now, will post txn id when done.

deploy-bot: no infra deploys required for this change.

tara_billing: transfer complete. txn `tx-9002`. ledger updated: credit `c-7890` now associated with org `org-ded-112` product: dedicated.

mike_eng_oncall: retried provisioning after txn. success log: 
```
Provisioning started -> pool_id p-1123 status active
```

jenny_support: passing confirmation to sam to verify with Acme. i've updated BL-7421 with txn `tx-9002` and notes.

sam_partner_success: Acme confirmed Dedicated pool is active, thank you all. they asked for root cause: partner portal labeled the promo as hosted when partner redeemed it. @mike_eng_oncall can eng-platform add validation to partner-sync to prevent product mismatches?

mike_eng_oncall: will open eng-platform ticket EP-1309 to add product validation to partner-sync and add a CI check on promo payloads. estimated fix ETA: 3 days for patch, 2 weeks for rollout. assigning to eng-platform.

jenny_support: loop closed on customer. BL-7421 contains txn `tx-9002`, audit `ev-33421`, and customer notification. marking thread resolved unless anyone sees follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

sam_partner_success: thanks everyone — big help. :pray:
